verdict.rationale: An official CLI is a plausible offering for an online IP-office service like DPMA, so this axis applies. However, the evidence only shows web portals (DPMAregister, DEPATISnet, DPMAdirektWeb), downloadable desktop filing software (DPMAdirektPro), and paper or fax filing. Nothing mentions a command-line interface, and the robots.txt probe says nothing about CLI tooling.
